title: The sharp one-dimensional Lieb-Thirring inequality for the sum of eigenvalues
summary: We prove that the best constant in the one-dimensional Lieb-Thirring inequality with exponent one is $4/(3\sqrt{3}π)$, confirming the Lieb-Thirring conjecture in this case. Moreover, we extend the inequality to operator-valued potentials and obtain the bound $L_{1,d}\leq(2/\sqrt3)L_{1,d}^{\mathrm{cl}}$ in every dimension.
